title: [Temp Check] Upgrade the v4 Protocol Fee System
headline: A temp check proposes replacing the v4 fee policy so governance can set protocol fees per hook using reusable rulesets, with current fee levels unchanged.
summary: This temp check is part of the Uniswap protocol fee rollout and uses the expedited process: a five-day Snapshot followed by an onchain vote. v4 fees went live in July and v4 now accounts for roughly half of Uniswap volume, much of it from hooks. The proposal replaces the V4FeePolicy of the V4FeeAdapter on all eight chains where v4 fees are live. Fee levels stay unchanged for every pool currently paying the fee. Pools using Uniswap Labs-owned hooks are opted in, and fees are not enabled on third-party hooks. Fee resolution runs in order: a pool-specific override, the hookless ruleset, a governance-assigned ruleset for the hook, the hooked static-fee ruleset, a hook that opts in by implementing getProtocolFee, then a global default, set to 0 here. If a ruleset reverts, the pool keeps its current fee. A parallel Snapshot would extend v4 fees to five more chains. Open questions include how future rulesets will be published and approved.
